extras: Requires external installation of the Neural Engine and PyTorch to function.
intentEvidence: This plugin automates the workflow while adding powerful native Obsidian integration!
motivation: To automate the workflow of digitizing handwritten notes and eliminate the time spent on manual processing.
problem: Manually processing and cleaning up notebook scans is time-consuming and inefficient.
summary: Inkporter digitizes handwritten notes into Obsidian using a local Neural Engine for intelligent ink isolation and automated workflow.
